## Introduction

My project explores the Melbourne Housing dataset. I will look at housing prices and how they vary based on property type, rooms, and location.

## Load Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
housing <- read_csv("Melbourne_housing_FULL.csv",
                    na = c("", "NA", "#N/A"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Explore Data

```{r}
# Check data
dim(housing)
names(housing)
head(housing)
```

## Missing Values

```{r}
# Check missing values
colSums(is.na(housing))
```

Some columns have missing values, so I will keep them for now and handle them when needed.

## Parsing Issues

```{r}
# Check reading errors
problems(housing)
```

## Clean Data

```{r}
# Keep rows with type and region
housing_clean <- housing |>
  filter(!is.na(Type), !is.na(Regionname))

# Check rows and columns
dim(housing_clean)
```

## Save Data

```{r}
# Save for Shiny app
saveRDS(housing_clean, "housing_clean.rds")
```

## Categorical Summaries

I looked at the number of properties by type and region.

### One-Way Tables

```{r}
# Property types
table(housing_clean$Type)

# Regions
table(housing_clean$Regionname)
```

### Two-Way Table

I compared property types across regions.

```{r}
# Type by region
table(housing_clean$Type, housing_clean$Regionname)
```

## Numerical Summaries

I compared housing prices across property types.

```{r}
# Price summary by type
housing_clean |>
  group_by(Type) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Price, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

I also compared the number of rooms across regions.

```{r}
# Room summary by region
housing_clean |>
  group_by(Regionname) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Rooms, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Rooms, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Rooms, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Graphical Summaries

### Plot 1: Property Types

This plot shows the number of properties for each type.

```{r}
# Bar chart
ggplot(housing_clean, aes(x = Type)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Number of Properties by Type",
       x = "Property Type",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot 2: Property Types by Region

This plot compares property types across different regions.

```{r}
# Grouped bar chart
ggplot(housing_clean, aes(x = Regionname, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Property Types by Region",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Property Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Plot 3: Housing Prices by Property Type

This plot shows how housing prices are distributed for each property type.

```{r}
# Histogram
ggplot(housing_clean |> filter(!is.na(Price)),
       aes(x = Price, fill = Type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(title = "Housing Prices by Property Type",
       x = "Price",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```


### Plot 4: Housing Prices by Type

This plot compares housing prices for different property types.

```{r}
# Boxplot
ggplot(housing_clean |> filter(!is.na(Price)),
       aes(x = Type, y = Price, fill = Type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Housing Prices by Property Type",
       x = "Property Type",
       y = "Price") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot 5: Rooms and Housing Prices

This plot shows how the number of rooms relates to housing prices.

```{r}
# Scatterplot
ggplot(housing_clean |> filter(!is.na(Price)),
       aes(x = Rooms, y = Price, color = Type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Rooms vs Housing Prices",
       x = "Number of Rooms",
       y = "Price",
       color = "Property Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot 6: Distance and Housing Prices

This plot compares distance from the city center and housing prices for different property types.

```{r}
# Faceted scatterplot
ggplot(housing_clean |>
         filter(!is.na(Price), !is.na(Distance)),
       aes(x = Distance, y = Price, color = Regionname)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(title = "Distance vs Housing Prices",
       x = "Distance from City Center (km)",
       y = "Price",
       color = "Region") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot 7: Average Housing Prices by Region and Type

This heatmap shows the average housing price for each property type across regions.

```{r}
# Calculate average prices
avg_prices <- housing_clean |>
  group_by(Regionname, Type) |>
  summarise(AvgPrice = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Heatmap
ggplot(avg_prices, aes(x = Type, y = Regionname, fill = AvgPrice)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Average Housing Prices by Region and Type",
       x = "Property Type",
       y = "Region",
       fill = "Average Price") +
  theme_minimal()
```
